dialogues.speaker: Wakamatsu
dialogues.text: Please, Master! Take me in as your disciple!

dialogues.speaker: Wen the Fourth
dialogues.text: As long as you ensure that you will practice more...

dialogues.speaker: Wakamatsu
dialogues.text: Holding buckets with my arms outstretched, holding a low stance under a waterfall... I'll do them all!

dialogues.speaker: Wen the Fourth
dialogues.text: Young man, such martial arts training methods don't exist.

dialogues.speaker: Wakamatsu
dialogues.text: Haha. Once I learn this stuff, it's time to show them what for, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Wen the Fourth
dialogues.text: *sigh* Young man, are you listening to me?

dialogues.speaker: Wen the Fourth
dialogues.text: You need to start from the fundamentals, like that non-initiated disciple at the practice hall. Start with the wooden stakes as your foe...
